acceptance_signals: One strict Evidence Freshness record references release/current.json and docs/releases/0.3.0rc1.md, uses docs/release-channels.md as its policy reference, and stores no raw evidence content.
The record passes agentgov check evidence-freshness with an explicit 2026-08-22 as-of date.
Focused tests prove the real record is current and that each declared event invalidates only by exact observed-event membership.
The specification, strategic plan, current status, and dated session record state whether the real event vocabulary is understandable and preserve the no-automatic-integration boundary.
The focused tests, complete supported Python 3.11 suite, repository governance check, JSON parsing, privacy scan, scope reconciliation, and git diff check pass.

decision.rationale: The accountable human reviewed structured proposal prp-bf6363479a644bb5b241c650609f523a and admitted that exact task through an explicit admission control.

requirement.summary: Add one repository-native Evidence Freshness v1 record for the bundled 0.3.0rc1 source compatibility baseline, validate its declared invalidating-event vocabulary against the existing deterministic checker, and record the bounded real-use review without adding automatic integration.

items: The bundled source manifest must not be represented as the immutable public release manifest.
Vague event names could make accountable producers unsure when to declare an observed invalidation.
A documentation-only review must not be presented as automatic change discovery or proof of broader consumer usability.
Current status and strategy must distinguish this real-use review from future repository or CI integration.
Reviewed assumption: The bundled 0.3.0rc1 source compatibility baseline is a real, longer-lived governance evidence item suitable for the first bounded trial.
Reviewed assumption: A null expiry and null review-due date are appropriate because the release-channel policy declares neither an expiry nor a review cadence.
Reviewed assumption: The task may add tests and evidence documentation without changing checker behavior or schema.
Reviewed unknown: Whether a future consumer finds the event names equally understandable remains unknown until external use.

title: Apply Evidence Freshness to one real release baseline
